en: And we're at a dead end! What're we{SAUT}gonna do!?
The gate that alternates between open{SAUT}and closed states is just up ahead...
Let's destroy the FOE.{OPTION}Let's lead the FOE there.
What, we're destroying it with our fists?{SAUT}In that case, leave it to me.
Hey moron, there's no way you or{SAUT}anybody is punching that thing{SAUT}and living to talk about it!
U-Um...{PAGE}Wouldn't the closed door open up if we{SAUT}led the pursuing FOE through the gate?
Ah, that's a great idea.{PAGE}If we have the pursuing FOE go through{SAUT}the gate, the currently closed door will{SAUT}open for us... Is that your plan?
I can definitely see that working. Let's{SAUT}give it a try, Joker!
